name: bash-fixes
description: Fixes for Claude's Bash tool on Windows Git Bash: long commands run from a temp script, rg keeps patterns that start with /, a no-op sed -i fails, rm targets that start with a variable get the ${VAR:?} guard so the empty-variable check doesn't ask (an rm ask the guard can't clear is refused with what to write), a double-quoted pwsh -Command body with $ is refused, pipefail and errexit stop a git write after a failed step, and `edits` makes all-or-nothing text edits that keep line endings.
